## 1. Two tech companies tried to reinvent the e-bike. Why DJI’s Amflow soared while Rivian’s ALSO floundered

- 分類：品牌新品｜全球
- 摘要：Two of the most interesting new electric bicycle companies in the world made headlines on the same day last week, and for two very different reasons. Amflow, the electric bicycle brand that emerged from the same engineering ecosystem responsible for DJI’s revolutionary Avinox drive system, just launched its first commuter e-bike to widespread acclaim. Meanwhile, ALSO, the high-tech electric bicycle startup spun out of Rivian, announced that it was halting deliveries of its futuristic TM-B electric bicycle amid mounting software problems. more…
